world_target.definition: 100% of the intended world footprint has meaningful gameplay, environmental, systemic, narrative, social, traversal, or discovery purpose.
world_target.fully_accessible_definition: 84% of the meaningful footprint can be physically entered, traversed, explored, occupied, or directly interacted with in gameplay.

accessibility_rule: A decorative building or terrain area cannot count as fully accessible unless the player can enter or meaningfully use it for a gameplay purpose.
world_density_rule: Remote terrain, islands, underground areas, roads, water, mountains and natural spaces must each have authored reasons to exist; empty filler is not counted as meaningful coverage.
